company.shortDescription: PowerUp Money is a financial technology firm that provides a digital platform for mutual fund investment advisory and portfolio management.
company.description: PowerUp Money is a financial technology firm that provides a digital platform for mutual fund investment advisory and portfolio management. It offers tools that let users review, select, and rebalance mutual fund portfolios through a mobile application, along with personalized investment guidance services. The company’s platform supports a subscription-based advisory tier as well as tools aimed at helping individuals plan and manage their financial goals. PowerUp Money also integrates features for financial insights and goal-oriented planning to support self-directed investing. Its services are designed to help individuals evaluate and manage their investment options within a single digital interface.
